name: Pocket Wiki
description:
## What it does

Search crafts, upgrade chains, material sources and uses inside the game. Bookmark pages, calculate attempt costs and pin recipes while playing.

## How to use

1. Install and enable Pocket Wiki in Studio. Installing Boss Atlas does not install Pocket Wiki.
2. Launch your normal game client and enter a character.
3. Click Pocket Wiki near the top-left of the game screen, or press Ctrl+U with chat closed.
4. Search by item name or ID, select a result, then browse its crafts, upgrades, sources and uses. Use Bookmark or Pin to keep useful information nearby.

## Shortcuts

- Ctrl+U: show or hide Pocket Wiki by default.
- F12: optional alternative, selected in the add-on settings.
- NONE: disables the keyboard shortcut; keep Show button enabled to open the wiki by clicking it.
- Existing game bindings and focused chat/input take priority over add-on shortcuts.

## Settings

Open Studio > Installed add-ons > Pocket Wiki > Details. Shortcut chooses Ctrl+U, F12 or NONE. Show button controls the Pocket Wiki button. Close the client, review and apply the settings, then launch it again. The server can stay running.

## Good to know

Studio can be closed while you play. Reference information is a local snapshot, not live server telemetry; use Review reference-data refresh after content changes. Bookmarks, history and window preferences are kept locally.
